page.overview:
Who is Achao?

Achao is a member of the Giant Warrior Pirates.

Achao is an average-sized giant with short black hair and a black narrow mustache that points upwards. He wears a fur cape, plate armor around his waist, and blue pants.

Achao is a sociable person, offering explanations to the Straw Hat Pirates when they lacked knowledge on matters related to Elbaph. Like most giants of Elbaph, Achao despised Loki for his actions and supposed murder of Harald, calling him the "Shame of Ebalph". Like other giants, he admires Nika.

As a giant, Achao possesses superhuman strength and resistance, quite sufficient to break a huge Marine ship with bare hands, and also competed in hand-to-hand combat against Killingham's creations called MMA.
